title: Mock: 45-minute LLD/OOD
summary: Timed 45-minute LLD/OOD mocks with the tutor as interviewer: scope, domain model, Go interfaces, a coded core path, a requirement change at minute 30, and probes, scored on a seven-dimension senior rubric; unlocks after B1 and B2.

units.title: The 45-minute LLD round under the clock

outcomes.text: Run a 45-minute LLD round to the clock: scope by 0:05, domain model with state owners by 0:12, the API as Go signatures by 0:15, a coded and tested core path by 0:30, and a clean stop at 0:45.
Turn an underspecified prompt into 3–5 requirements, an explicit out-of-scope list and the named axes of change that justify each interface.
Absorb a requirement change released at minute 30 as an addition behind an existing seam, or name the smallest edit when it lands on an axis you did not open.
State who owns every piece of shared mutable state and which lock or goroutine guards it, and answer concurrency probes with a specific mechanism and its cost.
Answer LLD probes (scale-up, failure, concurrency, extensibility, testing, over-engineering, security, why not X) with claim → why here → cost → when it flips.
Score your own mock on the seven-dimension rubric with one line of evidence per dimension, within one level of the tutor's score.
